name.zh: Cycadeoidea 本内苏铁类干化石

description.en: An armored fossil trunk preserves reproductive structures embedded among leaf bases.
description.zh: 甲胄状化石干体在叶基之间保存嵌入式生殖结构。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Cycadeoidea, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Cycadeoidea 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Embedded reproductive pockets and preserved trunk anatomy provide a specimen use unlike the existing generic leafy cycad.
distinctness.zh: 嵌入生殖腔及保存干体结构提供区别于现有有叶普通苏铁的标本用途。

modeling_brief.en: Build the fossil trunk surface with leaf-base blocks and recessed cone sites; do not add an invented leafy crown.
modeling_brief.zh: 以叶基块及凹入球果位置构成化石干表，不添加臆造叶冠。

uncertainty: Adult leaves are inadequately known; bennettitaleans are not true cycads.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
